text: I don't understand why you wouldn't want a woman like me. I am successful. I am rich. I can fight. I'm sick of men telling me, oh, well, you know, you're hardcore. Yes, I am. I am. Can you handle it? Oh, well, what you bringing to the table? I am the table. And she doesn't understand why men do not want a woman like her? You say you are the table. Well, if that's the table, I'd rather grab some fast food or cook for myself. Worst case, I can eat on the floor. I don't need a table that screams at me while I'm trying to have a dinner. But seriously, does she really think what men are looking for in a woman is I'm rich. I'm successful. I can fight. I'm hardcore. Can you handle it? Most men don't wake up thinking, I hope my woman can beat me up and outflex me in an argument. They want peace. They want warmth. They want respect. They want to feel like a man next to their woman. Her whole pitch is a CV for a corporate job. I am successful. I am rich. I can fight. Don't be afraid if you're applying to be a head of security. As a partner, men care way more about, are you kind? Are you loyal? Are you feminine? A healthy man doesn't want to handle his woman like a problem. He wants to cherish her because she makes his life better, not harder. So if you keep shouting, I am the table with this level of aggression, don't be surprised when men decide they're better off eating somewhere else.
